# technitium_zone_permission (Resource)

Grants a user or group access to one zone. Only this entry is managed; others on the zone are left alone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "technitium_zone_permission" "external_dns" {
  zone       = "k8s.example.com"
  user       = technitium_user.external_dns.username
  can_view   = true
  can_modify = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) Zone name.

### Optional

- `can_delete` (Boolean) Delete permission.
- `can_modify` (Boolean) Modify permission.
- `can_view` (Boolean) View permission.
- `group` (String) Group to grant to (`Everyone` included).
- `user` (String) Username to grant to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<zone>/user/<name>` or `<zone>/group/<name>`; also the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <zone>/group/<name> or <zone>/user/<name>
terraform import technitium_zone_permission.external_dns k8s.example.com/user/external-dns
```
